tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Command Words & Question Types

questions.question: Q: What is the difference between 'state' and 'explain' in an exam question?
questions.correctAnswer: 'State' needs only a brief factual answer with no reasoning; 'explain' requires you to give reasons, linking cause and effect.

questions.question: Q: A question asks you to 'compare half-wave and full-wave rectification'. What should your answer include?
questions.correctAnswer: Both similarities (both convert AC to DC using diodes) and differences (full-wave uses both half-cycles, half-wave only one; full-wave has higher output and less ripple).

questions.question: Q: How should you approach a 'calculate' question worth 3 marks?
questions.correctAnswer: Write the formula (1 mark), substitute the correct values (1 mark), and give the final numerical answer with correct units (1 mark).

tests.name: Exam-Style Practice
tests.description: Short-answer practice on Command Words & Question Types

questions.question: Q: What does 'evaluate' require that 'describe' does not?
questions.correctAnswer: 'Evaluate' requires a judgement supported by evidence, weighing up strengths and weaknesses; 'describe' only needs a factual account of what happens.

questions.question: Q: Why is it important to check the number of marks for a question?
questions.correctAnswer: The number of marks indicates how many separate points or steps are expected; a 4-mark question needs roughly four distinct points or development stages.
